## What this PR does

- [ ] Adds a new entry

## Checklist

- [ ] Every fact I changed is backed by the **official** page, linked in the entry.
- [ ] The entry follows the format in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) (At-a-glance row + full entry + reality check).
- [ ] I updated the At-a-glance table at the top of the file.
- [ ] If the deadline is within the next 90 days, I added / updated the row in `deadlines.md`.
- [ ] No affiliate, referral, or aggregator links.
